top_concerns: Main gains are shown mostly in cross-play against attackers from the same framework; no independent/adaptive attacks and no comparison with other defenses
AgentDojo gains are about 1 point (6.3->5.4 ASR; Qwen 1.6->1.4), matched by SPAG, with low base ASR and unspecified attack setup
Diversity claim rests on cumulative-set average pairwise embedding distance, with no baseline comparison or semantic analysis
Baselines (ART, w/o PBL) look under-tuned (weak attackers), so the PBL benefit may be overstated; no cycling measurement or sensitivity analysis
Narrow leakage-only string-match threat model, no over-refusal test, high residual ASR (34-41%) and TSR drop under strong attack
